Help Preserve Telugu Christian Hymn Heritage

This work is dedicated to collecting, researching and documenting Telugu Christian hymns, the writers who created them, and the history behind their songs.

The Work

Preserving the stories behind the songs

Alongside this website, the project includes the preparation of books such as Andhra Kraistava Keerthanalu – Ardamulu , documenting the meanings of Telugu Christian hymns together with information about their poets, authors, history and background.

This work involves collecting information about hymn writers, researching their lives and ministries, finding historical material, recording details about the songs, and organising everything so that this heritage can be preserved for future generations.

Financial contributions can help this work continue, especially by supporting the research, preparation and printing of these books.
